question: g4_orders_list
answer:
Created [ordersApi.mjs](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/okf/work/g4_orders_list/okf/codex/2/src/util/ordersApi.mjs) — an ES module with no imports, exporting `normalizeOrderList` (also as default). It reads the fields the backend's list response defines and maps them:

| Backend field (ReadableList/ReadableOrderList) | Output key |
|---|---|
| `orders: List<ReadableOrder>` | `orders` |
| `pageCount: int` | `pages` |
| `totalRecords: long` | `total` |
| `itemsOnPage: int` | `onThisPage` |

Missing or invalid values fall back to `[]` for the list and `0` for the counts; non-object input is safe. Verified with a quick node run: full, empty, and null inputs all normalize as expected. No other files were touched.

Files used: [okf/index.md](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/okf/work/g4_orders_list/okf/codex/2/okf/index.md) as the entry point, then [src/pages/other/RecentOrder.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/okf/work/g4_orders_list/okf/codex/2/src/pages/other/RecentOrder.js) + [src/util/constant.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/okf/work/g4_orders_list/okf/codex/2/src/util/constant.js) to identify the endpoint (`auth/orders/`), and the backend guide: [routes.md](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/okf/work/g4_orders_list/okf/codex/2/okf/references/backend/routes.md) (maps it to `OrderApi.list` → `ReadableOrderList`), plus the module pages for `ReadableOrderList` (v1 order model) and `ReadableList` (entity model) for the exact field names.
